metadata.description: Mock question bank for Phase 1 seed data. Manually tagged with CO, Bloom's level, CT skill, and marks.

questions.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
questions.question: Define a stack and list its primary operations with their time complexities.

questions.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
questions.question: Explain how a queue differs from a stack. Describe the enqueue and dequeue operations using a suitable example.

questions.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
questions.question: Implement a function in Python to reverse a singly linked list iteratively. Trace your algorithm on the list [1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> NULL].

questions.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
questions.question: Analyze the best-case, worst-case, and average-case time complexities of QuickSort. Under what conditions does QuickSort degrade to O(n²) and how can this be mitigated?

questions.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
questions.question: Evaluate the trade-offs between using an adjacency matrix versus an adjacency list for representing a sparse graph. Justify which representation you would choose for Dijkstra's algorithm.

questions.subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
questions.question: Design a data structure to implement an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with O(1) get and put operations. Provide the class definition with all methods and explain your design choices.

questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question: List the four necessary conditions for deadlock to occur in a system.

questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question: Compare and contrast preemptive and non-preemptive CPU scheduling algorithms. Provide one example algorithm for each category.

questions.subject: Operating Systems
questions.question: Given the following set of processes with their arrival times and burst times, compute the average waiting time and turnaround time using the Round Robin algorithm with a quantum of 4ms: P1(0,10), P2(1,5), P3(2,8).

questions.subject: Database Management Systems
questions.question: Identify and explain all functional dependencies present in the relation R(A, B, C, D, E) given that: A → BC, CD → E, B → D, E → A. Find the closure of {A} and determine all candidate keys.

questions.subject: Computer Networks
questions.question: Trace the execution of the TCP three-way handshake and explain what happens to the connection if the final ACK is lost.

questions.subject: Machine Learning
questions.question: Design a convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture for classifying handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset. Specify layer types, filter sizes, activation functions, and justify each design decision.
